expected_data_structure: Long format: one row per indicator x country x year (x sex for prevalence). MPOWER levels are text categories in value_text; prevalence is numeric in value with low/high. Optional wide country-year panel.
known_limitations: MPOWER group levels are ordinal categories delivered as text ('1'-'5', 'Not applicable'); they are not converted to numeric scores. The meaning of each level differs by measure and must be taken from the WHO report technical notes.
MPOWER data exist only for report years (2007, 2008, 2010, ... 2022); intermediate years are absent by design and are not interpolated.
The GHO API provides neither units nor definitions; these come from the configuration and WHO documentation.
Prevalence series include modelled estimates and projections (2023-2030); the 2007-2022 window excludes projections beyond 2022.
For some countries, tobacco smoking estimates substitute for tobacco use estimates (see the comments column).
outstanding_decisions: Confirm that all 195 countries and the 2007-2022 period are wanted.
Confirm that age-standardised current tobacco use prevalence by sex should be included as a contextual variable.
Confirm the interpretation of each MPOWER group level against the WHO report technical notes before analysis.
